en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – June 3, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include Cisco winning the TechMahaImpacT Award for digital inclusion, MSCI announcing its upcoming global market accessibility review, Atlassian hosting Accessibility Design Week 2026, and a neurodevelopmental awareness program promoting inclusion of neurodiverse individuals.

highlights.title: Cisco Team Wins TechMahaImpacT Award for Connectivity & Digital Inclusion
MSCI to Release 2026 Global Market Accessibility Review Results
